english.title: Importer fail to identify an economic operator who supplied / to whom he supplied a category F1/F2/F3 firework
english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 37, 62(2)(r) and 63(1)(a) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being an importer of a pyrotechnic article
received a request from the market surveillance authority
before the end of the relevant period
failed to identify any economic operator who supplied you with / to whom you supplied

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) does not apply (i.e. not a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is triable either way - see offence document H12342 (CJS code PA15105)
(ii) The relevant period is -
(a) where an economic operator has supplied a pyrotechnic article, a period of 10 years beginning on the day on which the pyrotechnic article was supplied;
(b) where the manufacturer has supplied an economic operator with a pyrotechnic article, a period of 10 years beginning on the day on which he supplied the pyrotechnic article.
